name: sign_a
prompt: Straight-on flat scan of one old enamel hospital wayfinding sign plate, fills the entire image edge to edge with no background and no perspective. Pale cream panel with a dull teal band on the left. Three simple black pictograms in a row: wheelchair symbol, hospital bed symbol, arrow pointing right. Absolutely no letters, no words, no numbers. Worn, faded, light scratches, dusty, clean surface, no rust stains. Evenly lit.

name: paper
prompt: Top-down flat scan of a single old aged sheet of paper, fills the entire image edge to edge, no background. Faint printed grid form lines, a small blank box at the top, and pale pencil scribble strokes that are not real letters. Soft creases, slightly yellowed, clean, evenly lit. No readable text.
